name: Lockheed Martin Corporation
operational_role: World's largest defense contractor; primary manufacturer of tactical aircraft, precision-guided missiles, radar systems, and air defense platforms for the US military and foreign military sales allies including Israel.
government_liaisons: Israeli Ministry of Defense / Israeli Air Force
documented_activities: Manufacturer of weapons systems heavily deployed in US and Israeli military operations across the Middle East, including the F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-35 Lightning II (Adir), Hellfire missiles, PAC-3 Patriot missiles, and precision-guided standoff munitions used in Iraq, Lebanon, and Gaza.
documented_consequences: Record surges in defense revenues and shareholder capital returns during post-9/11 US military engagements in Iraq and Afghanistan, and recurring supply contracts during major regional military escalations.
